IKEv1.finding: IKEv1 is legacy and vulnerable to aggressive mode PSK offline cracking and key negotiation flaws.

3DES.finding: 3DES is vulnerable to Sweet32 64-bit block cipher attacks and deprecated by NIST.

DES.finding: DES uses obsolete 56-bit key length vulnerable to brute force.

SHA-1.finding: SHA-1 has known collision vulnerabilities and is deprecated for cryptographic integrity.

MD5.finding: MD5 is severely broken cryptographically and vulnerable to collision attacks.

Group 2.finding: DH Group 2 (1024-bit) provides insufficient security margin against state-level precomputation.

Group 1.finding: DH Group 1 (768-bit) is obsolete and vulnerable to precomputation.

None.finding: No DH group configured; key exchange cannot be established securely.

Disabled.finding: PFS is disabled. Compromise of long-term private key exposes all past recorded IPsec sessions.
Anti-replay protection is disabled, leaving the tunnel vulnerable to packet replay attacks.

Any.finding: Overly broad traffic selectors increase attack surface and risk unintended traffic redirection.

0.0.0.0/0.finding: Wildcard 0.0.0.0/0 traffic selector allows unconstrained subnet traversal.
